description: Rural grid-connected household with lights, phone charging, radio and TV (MTF Tier 2-like). DRAFT: ownership from DHS 2025; power and usage are assumptions awaiting evidence extraction and human review.

ownership_share.assumption: Grid-connected households use electricity as main lighting (EICV7 Table A.8 counts grid lighting as 'electricity distributors'); every archetype member owns bulbs.

number.assumption: Three rooms lit (living room, bedroom, outside); to replace with MTF Rwanda 2018 lighting data.

windows.assumption: 18:00-23:00 and 05:00-07:00 (sunrise ~06:00, sunset ~18:00 all year at 2 deg S).

func_cycle.assumption: Lights stay on at least 30 min once switched on.

time_fraction_random_variability.assumption: RAMP example-file value for indoor lights.

ownership_share.derivation: Rural households with any type of mobile phone (FR401 Table 2.5). The API indicator HC_HEFF_H_MPH (0.735) counts ordinary phones only. Unconditional share: households without electricity also own phones (charged elsewhere), so this may overstate charging at home slightly.

number.assumption: One phone charged per household per day.

windows.assumption: Charged in the evening and overnight.

func_cycle.assumption: One charge lasts at least an hour.

ownership_share.derivation: Unconditional rural ownership. Many radios are battery-powered, so ownership among grid households can't be derived from this share; used as-is.

func_cycle.assumption: Listening sessions of 30 min or more.

ownership_share.derivation: P(TV | electricity) ~ P(TV) / P(electricity) = 0.072 / 0.418, assuming TVs are only in electrified rural households (an upper bound: some run on solar home systems).

power.assumption: 32-inch LED TV 30-50 W. Check: 40 W x 4.3 h x 30 d = 5.2 kWh/month, the TV consumption estimated in qsel_grid_reliability_2025 p13 (validation_anchors/residential_kwh_qsel.csv).

func_cycle.assumption: Viewing sessions of 1 h or more.
